As an Ads Quality Rater, you will review and grade internet advertisements to help shape how ads are delivered to the end users. In other words, you’ll tell the AI program how good or bad its advertisement suggestions are based on the user’s keywords.
 
You will review ads in both English and German

- Know what people want based on a few keywords  
- Enjoy researching topics online

About Welo Global 
Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. ROLE OVERVIEW
Welo Global is partnering with a social media client to build high-quality training data for AI systems. We are looking for Brazilian experts with PhD level to help create challenging, expert-level questions and answers in their field. The content that will directly shape how AI understands Brazilian culture, law, history, and society.
This is a remote, flexible freelance engagement. All work is done in Brazilian Portuguese.
What you'll do
For each assignment, you will craft a challenging, expert-level question on a Brazilian topic in your field (one that AI tools cannot fully answer), write the ideal response in Brazilian Portuguese and break that response down into individually cited facts with their sources and relevance.

Task: AI data annotation
Area of expertise (domain): Politics
Tools: Consumer-grade LLM with search (e.g., Gemini Pro), for prompt difficulty calibration
Estimated Volume: 60 hours over approximately 2 months, the hours are flexible, work on your own schedule
Location: Remote
Engagement Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

vagas.titulo: Portuguese Accessibility Tester
vagas.descricao:
About Welocalize 
Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
About the Role
Welocalize is expanding its network of accessibility testers to validate the language-specific accessibility of localized digital content: web pages, applications, and documents.
You will serve as a native-language expert reviewer, confirming that accessibility elements not only survive translation but are accurate, understandable, and functional in the target language.
This role requires fluency in the target language, hands-on experience with assistive technology in that language, and familiarity with Digital Accessibility standards and guidelines such as PDF/UA, WCAG 2.1 & 2.2, and EN 301 549 to complement accessibility testing done internally.
Work is assigned on a project basis. You will receive a defined scope, a testing checklist, and access credentials. Findings are reported in a structured defect log and specific bug tracking system.
What You Will Do
The actual scope will vary by assignment, but the general extent of this role is outlined below.
Language Validation: Confirm correct language codes in HTML and PDF metadata, and identify mixed-language content missing proper declarations.
In-Language Screen Reader Testing: Using native-language screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack, or Narrator), review translated accessible text — including hidden elements, tooltips, error messages, alt text, and UI labels — for accuracy, natural phrasing, and clarity when read aloud.
Multimedia Accessibility Review: Evaluate captions, transcripts, and audio descriptions for accuracy, synchronization, and natural language, and confirm multimedia controls are properly labeled in the target language.
Defect Reporting: Log findings with WCAG/PDF-UA references, supporting screenshots or recordings, and severity classifications; participate in review calls with the QA Lead as needed.
What We Are Looking For
Required
Native or near-native fluency in Portuguese; you are the authoritative voice on whether translated content reads naturally and is understandable.
Demonstrated hands-on experience testing digital content with assistive technology/AT.
Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 & 2.2 AA and EN 301 549.
Ability to evaluate content from a native-speaker accessibility perspective — not just technical compliance, but real-world usability for screen reader users who speak the language.
Reliable access to relevant devices and operating systems to replicate real-world usage in the target locale.
Nice to have
Strong written communication skills in English for defect reporting and general communications.
Experience with PDF accessibility testing using PAC 3 or Adobe Acrobat Pro Accessibility Checker.
Familiarity with internationalization, localization, and translation workflows; understanding of how accessibility elements can be affected during format conversion.
Personal use of assistive technology.
Tools and Environment
Welocalize provides access credentials and a structured test plan per engagement. Testers are expected to supply their own device and assistive technology setup appropriate to the target locale.
Commonly used tools in this role include: 
Screen readers: JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver (macOS/iOS), TalkBack (Android), Narrator (Windows)
Browser/screen reader pairings aligned to the target locale's most common usage patterns
Caption and transcript review: native video players, .srt/.vtt file review
PDF accessibility: PAC 3, Adobe Acrobat Pro (provided where required)
Defect logging: Jira bug tracking system is most frequently used
What to Expect
Assignments are project-based with clear scope documents, test checklists, and agreed turnaround timelines provided before work begins.
Scope for each engagement will specify the exact language, content type, pages or documents in scope, and priority areas.
You will not be expected to remediate or fix issues; your role is testing and reporting.
Welocalize values feedback: if checklist items are unclear or a finding falls outside the defined scope, flag it and we will address it.
How to Apply
Click on Apply Now button and share with us the following: 
A brief introduction covering your language, screen reader experience, and accessibility background.
Any relevant certifications (CPACC, WAS, DHS Trusted Tester, or equivalent).

vagas.titulo: Colaborador(a) de Coleta de Vídeos - Projeto de IA (Freelance / Remoto)
vagas.descricao:
Esta é uma oportunidade baseada em projetos em uma plataforma de treinamento de IA. Sem horário fixo, sem compromisso além do que se encaixa na sua rotina. Gravou, ganhou.

Sobre a Função

Estamos procurando pessoas para gravar vídeos em primeira pessoa de atividades domésticas do dia a dia. Você fixa o smartphone na cabeça, segue sua rotina normalmente, e a câmera captura exatamente o que você vê. Esses vídeos ajudam a treinar sistemas de IA e robôs a entender como as pessoas interagem com objetos em ambientes reais. Você lava louça todos os dias? Passa o aspirador no tapete? Passeia com o cachorro? Dobra roupa? E se você pudesse ganhar dinheiro apenas gravando isso? 

Responsabilidades

  • Gravar atividades domésticas do dia a dia em primeira pessoa — cozinhar, limpar, organizar, dobrar roupa, cuidar do jardim, passear com o cachorro, entre outras
  • Gravar em sua própria casa, quintal, garagem ou espaço de trabalho
  • Seguir orientações breves de gravação para cada sessão
  • Enviar os vídeos pelo aplicativo do projeto

Requisitos

  • Equipamento: Ter ou utilizar um smartphone ou outro dispositivo de câmera capaz de gravar a 30 FPS ou mais e resolução de 1080p ou superior. iPhone 12 ou mais recente, Google Pixel 6+ ou Samsung Galaxy S21+ (deve ter lente grande angular / 0.5x)
  • Método de captura: Fixar o dispositivo na altura da testa ou dos olhos para obter uma perspectiva egocêntrica, mantendo um ângulo levemente inclinado para baixo para maximizar a visibilidade das mãos
  • Software: Utilizar o aplicativo designado "D&A" para toda a captura e envio de dados
  • Controle de qualidade: Garantir que todas as filmagens estejam nítidas, estáveis, bem iluminadas, com pelo menos 15 segundos de duração, e que retratem tarefas úteis e intencionais, sem pausas desnecessárias ou movimentos forçados

Por que essa oportunidade freelance é perfeita para você? 

• Ganhe dinheiro enquanto faz suas tarefas domésticas: até o equivalente a $6 por hora, dependendo do projeto 

• Este é um trabalho freelance baseado em projetos — escolha as sessões de gravação de acordo com sua disponibilidade 

• Influencie o futuro de como a IA e os robôs entendem e interagem com o mundo real

vagas.titulo: First-Person AI Video Trainer
vagas.descricao:
This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You record, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more
  • Record in your own home, yard, garage, or workspace
  • Follow short recording guidelines per session
  • Upload videos through the project app

Requirements

  • Equipment: Own or use a smartphone or alternative camera device capable of 30 FPS or greater and 1080p resolution or greater. iPhone 12 or newer, Google Pixel 6+, or Samsung Galaxy S21+ (must have a wide-angle / 0.5x lens)
  • Capture method: Mount the device at forehead or eye-level for an egocentric perspective, maintaining a downward angle to maximize hand visibility.
  • Software: Utilize the designated "D&A" application for all data capture and upload.
  • Quality control: Ensure all video footage is clear, stable, well-lit, at least 15 seconds long, and accurately depicts useful, intentional tasks without unnecessary pauses or contrived movements.

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

• This is project-based freelance work — pick up recording sessions when they fit your schedule

• Influence the future of how AI and robots understand and interact with the real world
